delivery_methodology: The project will be delivered using an AI-enabled agile approach characterized by short, time-boxed development cycles with regular demonstrations and continuous client feedback. This iterative process allows for incremental releases and early validation of features, ensuring alignment with client expectations.

AI tools assist in drafting documentation, generating code snippets, and automating routine tasks, while human experts review, integrate, and approve all outputs to maintain quality and relevance. Scope changes are managed carefully to preserve project focus and delivery timelines. Quality assurance practices are embedded throughout the development lifecycle to ensure a reliable and maintainable system.
executive_summary: Kalinaw Trading Corporation seeks to implement a comprehensive Human Resource Information System (HRIS) to streamline HR operations, improve data accuracy, and enhance employee self-service capabilities. This initiative is critical to supporting the company's growth and ensuring efficient management of employee information, attendance, leave, and payroll integration.

Exist Software Labs proposes a tailored HRIS solution that aligns with Kalinaw Trading Corporation's operational needs and strategic goals. The system will be delivered using an AI-enabled agile methodology, ensuring iterative development with continuous client feedback. Upon completion, the client will receive a robust, cloud-deployed HRIS that supports management reporting, employee self-service, and seamless payroll interfacing.
proposed_solution: The proposed HRIS solution integrates key capabilities including employee information management, time and attendance tracking, leave management, payroll interfacing, and comprehensive reporting. It supports various user roles such as employees, HR staff, approvers, and management, facilitating workflows like leave applications, attendance corrections, and document tracking. The system is designed to fit Kalinaw Trading Corporation's organizational structure and approval processes, enhancing operational efficiency and data transparency.

This solution enables employees to access personal records and submit requests via mobile or desktop browsers, while HR staff can manage records, approvals, and reports effectively. The integration with the payroll system ensures accurate and timely data exchange, supporting payroll processing without additional encoding. Overall, the system addresses the client’s requirements for performance, security, and usability across all branches.
technical_architecture: The HRIS is architected as a cloud-deployed microservices system using a modern technology stack including Java with Spring Boot for backend services, React for the frontend, and PostgreSQL as the data store. The architecture includes separate environments for development, testing (UAT), and production to ensure quality and stability.

Services are designed to scale to support 300 concurrent users with high availability and performance targets. Integration with external payroll systems is handled through secure, auditable interfaces. Role-based access control, audit trails, and notifications are embedded to meet security and compliance requirements. The design supports mobile and desktop access, ensuring usability for all user groups.
warranty_support: The solution includes a warranty period during which any defects or issues identified will be promptly addressed and corrected at no additional cost. Defects can be reported through a defined process, ensuring timely resolution and minimal disruption to operations.

The warranty covers all functionality delivered as part of the project scope. Issues arising from changes made outside the agreed scope or from external factors are excluded. Post-warranty support and maintenance services are available as separate options to provide ongoing assistance and system enhancements.
